name: agentavow-trust
description: Automatically checks your MCP servers and packages before Claude uses them. At your next session start, Claude opens with one line: how many of your servers AgentAvow checked (including the ones your other plugins bring), how many are Safe to connect, and the one to look at first, plus the same for your project's direct dependencies (npm, PyPI and Rust crates). Add a server with `claude mcp add`, or install a package with npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, pip, uv, pipx or poetry, and it is checked first: Do not connect asks you, Review or deprecated is a one-line note, Safe stays silent. Every result leads with Safe to connect, Review before you connect, or Do not connect and its reason, over a signed 0-100 trust score you can verify offline. Also bundles the AgentAvow connector (scan any MCP server, package, or repo on demand), an /agentavow-trust:scan command, and a per-call gate that stops calls to a server that reads Do not connect, unless you allow that one server, and asks before a tool whose definition changed since it was checked. Fail-open; only the server URL or package name being graded leaves your machine.
